page.overview:
Who is Larry?

Larry is a character appearing in Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet. A salaryman who works a day job for Paldea's Pokémon League, he is both the Gym Leader at Medali's Gym and an Elite Four member.

He is referred to as "The Exceptional Everyman".

As a Gym Leader, Larry specializes in types. As an Elite Four member, he specializes in types.

Larry is a tall, thin, middle-aged man in business attire, wearing a black suit with a gray dress shirt underneath, and a blue cloud-print tie. There are two dark notches on each side of the suit lapels. He has very thick eyebrows, black hair with grey highlights,and square-shaped black eyes. In his role as an Elite Four member, he also wears black gloves with what appears to be a gray compass-like pattern engraved on them. He also carries a briefcase with him.
